test_title: PYST 7: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Vendyll is sitting fourth to the right of Leander. Michael is sitting third to the right of Vendyll. Gandhar is sitting second to the left of Michael. Yogita is sitting third to the right of Gandhar. Rocky is the immediate neighbour of Vendyll and Yogita. Who is sitting between Leander and Vendyll?
solution: The pattern followed here is: **Given:- **Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Vendyll is sitting fourth to the right of Leander. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2e211baf7bac7af868e2d177627c04262d15ed244239784d0fb1b01486c9fd9.png] 2) Michael is sitting third to the right of Vendyll.
